# Midas Ledger · homework for Gemini

Updated 2026-11-05 14:55 UTC · 8 open · Rules for every pillar: https://github.com/jpavia10/prometheus-hub/blob/main/AI_START_HERE.md. Your homework in every pillar on one page: Drive doc 'Prometheus Hub/Gemini/HOMEWORK — Gemini (every pillar)'.

## 1. MID-GEM-01 · 12 debt payoff cases worked to the cent

**Due:** 2026-11-09 · **State:** now

**Why:** Midas is getting a payoff planner (avalanche, snowball and Joseph's own order). Claude checks its engine against cases worked by someone else. No real balances: every case is made up.

**Do this:**
1. Make 12 made-up cases: 4 avalanche, 4 snowball, 4 'custom order'. Each has 2 to 6 debts (name, balance, APR %, minimum payment) and one monthly budget at least the sum of the minimums.
2. Rules, exactly: each month, interest = balance x APR / 12 / 100, rounded to the cent (half up); add it to the balance; pay every minimum (or the whole balance if smaller); the rest of the budget goes to the target debt (avalanche = highest APR, snowball = lowest balance, custom = the order you list); if the target is paid off with money left, the rest goes to the next target the same month; when a debt hits 0 its minimum joins the rest from the next month.
3. Work every case month by month until every balance is 0.
4. At least 3 cases must run longer than 36 months and at least 2 must have a debt paid off in the same month another target changes.

**Make:** `midas_gemini_payoff-cases_{YYYYMMDD-HHMM}.json`

**Save in:** Prometheus Hub/Pillars/Midas Ledger/incoming (AI drop files)/

**Shape:** `[{"case":1,"method":"avalanche","budget":900,"debts":[{"name":"Card A","balance":4210.55,"apr":24.99,"min":95}],"months":[{"m":1,"interest":{"Card A":87.68},"paid":{"Card A":900},"balance":{"Card A":3398.23}}],"payoff_month":{"Card A":6},"total_interest":312.40}] (12 objects)`

**How many:** 12

**Done when:** 12 cases, every month listed, and Claude's engine gets the same balance for every debt in every month.

**How Claude checks it:**
- Claude runs all 12 cases through its own engine; a balance more than $0.01 off in any month makes that case wrong.
- Claude checks the 36-month and same-month conditions.

**Not done (sent back) if:**
- a case whose months stop before every balance is 0
- a month that does not follow the rules above
- fewer than 12 cases

## 2. MID-GEM-02 · 20 research findings on what really helps people pay off debt, each with its DOI

**Due:** 2026-11-10 · **State:** now

**Why:** Joseph: the app must inspire him to get out of debt. Claude designs from evidence, not slogans.

**Read first:**
- Google Scholar, journal pages, NBER, Federal Reserve, CFPB (no blogs, no listicles, no AI summaries)

**Do this:**
1. Find 20 different published studies or official reports about paying down debt, motivation, small wins, framing, mental accounting, or progress feedback.
2. For each: full citation, DOI or official URL, the one finding in one sentence with its number (effect size, percent or dollars), and one concrete thing Midas should show because of it (a screen element, not advice).
3. Quote the abstract sentence the finding comes from, word for word.

**Make:** `midas_gemini_debt-research_{YYYYMMDD-HHMM}.json`

**Save in:** Prometheus Hub/Pillars/Midas Ledger/incoming (AI drop files)/

**Shape:** `[{"n":1,"citation":"Gal, D. & McShane, B. (2012) ...","doi":"10....","finding":"...","quote":"exact sentence from the abstract","midas":"show ..."}] (20 objects)`

**How many:** 20

**Done when:** 20 real studies, every DOI resolves to that paper, every quote is in its abstract.

**How Claude checks it:**
- Claude resolves all 20 DOIs and searches each quote in the abstract.
- One invented paper or invented quote = the whole file is rejected.

**Not done (sent back) if:**
- any paper that does not exist
- a quote that is not word for word
- a blog or news article in place of a study

## 3. MID-GEM-03 · 15 money apps taken apart: 75 things that make people keep going

## 4. MID-GEM-04 · Minimum payment formulas of 25 US card issuers, quoted from their cardholder agreements

**Due:** 2026-11-12 · **State:** now

**Why:** Midas's payoff engine (src/plan.js) keeps each minimum fixed; real minimums fall as the balance falls. The engine needs each issuer's real formula.

**Do this:**
1. Take the 25 largest US card issuers (Chase, American Express, Citi, Capital One, Bank of America, Discover, Synchrony, Wells Fargo, U.S. Bank, Barclays, Goldman Sachs/Apple Card, PNC, TD Bank, Navy Federal, USAA, Truist, Credit One, Comenity/Bread, Fifth Third, Citizens, Huntington, Regions, KeyBank, BMO, First National).
2. From each one's own cardholder agreement or pricing page, copy the minimum payment rule: the percent of balance, what is added (interest, fees, past due), the dollar floor, and when the whole balance is due instead.
3. Write the rule as a formula over balance B, interest I, fees F: e.g. max(35, 0.01*B + I + F), or B when B < 35.

**Make:** `midas_gemini_minimums_{YYYYMMDD-HHMM}.json`

**Save in:** Prometheus Hub/Pillars/Midas Ledger/incoming (AI drop files)/

**Shape:** `[{"n":1,"issuer":"...","product":"the card or card family the agreement covers","formula":"max(40, 0.01*B + I + F)","floor_usd":40,"pct_of_balance":1,"adds":["interest","fees"],"url":"https://...","quote":"..."}]`

**How many:** 25

**Done when:** 25 issuers, each formula traceable to the quoted agreement text.

**How Claude checks it:**

- Claude runs each formula on B=5000, I=80, F=0 and on B=20.

**Not done (sent back) if:**

## 8. MID-GEM-08 · 12 daily-compounding interest cases worked to the cent

**Due:** 2026-11-16 · **State:** now

**Why:** Before Midas switches to daily interest (MID-GEM-05), Claude needs cases worked by hand to test it against.

**Do this:**
1. Make 12 cases with balances between 500 and 25,000, APRs between 9.99 and 29.99, three 30-day cycles each, one payment per cycle on day 20 (amount of your choice), no new purchases.
2. Daily periodic rate = APR / 365 / 100; interest accrues on the day's balance and is added at the end of each cycle (state whether it compounds daily or monthly; do both for cases 1-3).
3. Write every cycle: start balance, sum of daily balances, average daily balance, interest (rounded half up to the cent), payment, end balance.

**Make:** `midas_gemini_dailycases_{YYYYMMDD-HHMM}.json`

**Save in:** Prometheus Hub/Pillars/Midas Ledger/incoming (AI drop files)/

**Shape:** `[{"case":1,"balance":5000.00,"apr":24.99,"payment_day":20,"payments":[200,200,200],"compounding":"monthly","cycles":[{"start":5000.00,"sum_daily":147800.00,"adb":4926.67,"interest":101.19,"payment":200.00,"end":4901.19}]}] (days 1-19 at 5000.00, days 20-30 at 4800.00)`

**How many:** 12

**Done when:** 12 cases x 3 cycles; Claude recomputes every number in Python.

**How Claude checks it:**
